shared_elements: repeated small motifs arranged in rows/groups
justification: Both surfaces include human figures and repeated small signs, but that is as far as it goes: A shows a single elaborately costumed frontal figure seated within an architectural niche, framed by dense columns of ornate glyph-like blocks, while B shows scattered, tiny stick-like figures, hand/foot shapes and long crewed boats with rows of vertical strokes dispersed freely over an open surface. The manner of depiction is utterly different — deeply modelled, crowded, hierarchical and near-naturalistic detail in A versus flat, minimal silhouette outlines with no framing or ground in B.
